description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git's subtree merge strategy. It contains a series of setup steps, test cases, and validations to verify the behavior of subtree merging in Git repositories.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case with a given description.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes provided lines to a specified file.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files or inputs.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Verifies that a specified path is a file.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified changes.

methods.name: git hash-object
methods.description: Calculates the hash of a file's contents.

methods.name: git commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with staged changes.

methods.name: git checkout
methods.description: Switches branches or restores working tree files.

methods.name: git merge
methods.description: Merges another branch into the current branch.

methods.name: git pull
methods.description: Fetches from and integrates with another repository or a local branch.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
